import urllib.request
import json
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

# Get FICD
url_ficd = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9BVA6.json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url_ficd, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/3.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
    data_ficd = json.loads(response.read().decode())

seq_ficd = data_ficd['sequence']['value']
mw_ficd = ProteinAnalysis(seq_ficd).molecular_weight()
print(f"FICD UniProt reported molWeight: {data_ficd['sequence'].get('molWeight')}")
print(f"FICD calculated MW: {mw_ficd:.2f} Da ({mw_ficd/1000:.2f} kDa), length: {len(seq_ficd)}")

# Get PGM1
url_pgm1 = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P36871.json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url_pgm1, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/3.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
    data_pgm1 = json.loads(response.read().decode())

seq_pgm1 = data_pgm1['sequence']['value']
mw_pgm1 = ProteinAnalysis(seq_pgm1).molecular_weight()
print(f"PGM1 UniProt reported molWeight: {data_pgm1['sequence'].get('molWeight')}")
print(f"PGM1 calculated MW: {mw_pgm1:.2f} Da ({mw_pgm1/1000:.2f} kDa), length: {len(seq_pgm1)}")
